stem.text: Which diagram best shows the forces acting on a ball falling at a constant velocity through a liquid?

A.alt: Ball with two upward arrows labelled upthrust and viscous drag and one downward arrow labelled weight; the upthrust and viscous drag labels are on the left and right at the top

B.alt: Ball with one upward arrow labelled viscous drag and one downward arrow labelled weight

C.alt: Ball with one upward arrow labelled upthrust and one downward arrow labelled weight

D.alt: Ball with two upward arrows labelled upthrust and viscous drag and one downward arrow labelled weight; the labels are placed at a higher level
